title: OpenSea founded
description: OpenSea was founded in 2017 and became a major general NFT marketplace.
notes: Launch year is treated as year-precision pending an official primary source.

title: GameStop NFT beta launched
description: GameStop opened the public beta of its NFT marketplace in July 2022.
notes: Use this as the marketplace launch event for the validation batch.

title: GameStop NFT marketplace shut down
description: GameStop's NFT marketplace was reported as closing on February 2, 2024, after the company cited continuing regulatory uncertainty around crypto assets.
notes: Official archived notice still needed before promotion to canonical production data.

title: KnownOrigin founded
description: KnownOrigin launched as an Ethereum art NFT marketplace in 2018.
notes: Launch year is year-precision pending direct primary confirmation.

title: KnownOrigin acquired by eBay
description: eBay acquired KnownOrigin in June 2022, ending KnownOrigin's status as an independent marketplace company.
notes: Acquisition event is the validation batch's acquired/reclassified case.
